text:
maria (AE): Quick heads-up — FinTechCo POC asking for strict EU-only data residency with APAC as cold DR.
They want: full subprocessor list by region, can we pin tenant to EU and only failover to APAC on outage, and impact on POC pricing (hosted vs dedicated). Also they're about to send an RFI/security questionnaire.

kevin (SolutionsEng): Short answer: Hosted API is region-preferred but not isolated. We can route by geofence+affinity (preference) but can't guarantee zero cross-region egress on shared hosted for strict-regulatory commitments.
Dedicated or Private deployment = single-tenant routing + KMS/BYOK, so you can meet 'EU-only' requirements. For POC we normally do a temporary Dedicated reservation.
Subprocessors (high level): AWS (eu-west-1, eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1), GCP (europe-west4, asia-southeast1), Cloudflare (CDN/edge), Sentry, Datadog. Full list + certs in the doc below.

sarah (Product): We have a routing policy config that supports tenant_pin + fallback order. Example snippet we can hand to ops:
```
{"tenant_id":"fintechco-poc","routing":{"type":"pin","preferred_region":"eu","failover":["apac"],"sticky":true}}
```
This will keep traffic in EU unless a capacity/region failure triggers failover. Note: prefix KV caching and batching may still touch downstream services in other regions if model instance spans zones.

dave (Legal): Please get the full subprocessor inventory + SOC2 and DPA references. Also need to know if we can add subprocessor restrictions into the SOW (customer wants that clause). If Dedicated, easier; for Hosted we need to review with cloud providers and legal.

maria (AE): Thanks — I'll upload the RFI later today. FinTechCo asked for estimated delta on POC pricing if we do Dedicated vs Hosted small-scale: any ballpark for quoting?

kevin (SolutionsEng): Ballpark for a small Dedicated POC (reserved GPU pool, single region) is ~$8k–12k/month depending on GPU class and ingress egress needs. Hosted (no dedicated infra) is per-usage with no reservation but cannot provide contractual region isolation. Also note there's an activation/setup fee for Dedicated provisioning (~1–2 weeks lead time).

infra-bot: Internal doc: https://redwood.internal/ops/geo-routing-subprocessors — includes full subprocessor CSV, cert attachments, and the Dedicated provisioning checklist.

maria (AE): Perfect — tagging @kevin to prepare the subprocessor export and @dave for legal notes. I'll respond to the customer with the config snippet and the ballpark pricing. :thumbsup:

kevin (SolutionsEng): ACK, will export and DM the certs. Also suggest we propose a staged approach: Hosted for initial demo (no contractual residency), then Dedicated for contract phase if they need EU-only. Keeps friction low.

dave (Legal): +1 on staged approach. Also request customer's exact language for 'EU-only' (data at rest vs metadata vs control plane). That matters for SOW.

maria (AE): Good call — will ask them and paste answer here when they respond.
